req.title: Rate limit not enforced
req.statement: The system shall not throttle single-client request rates below 60/min.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-039 states the system shall NOT throttle single-client request rates below 60/min, meaning all 60 requests within a minute must succeed with HTTP 2xx. The SUT (fastapi-task-manager) has no rate-limiting middleware in the visible source, so every request to any endpoint should return 2xx. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — 60 sequential GET /tasks/ requests all return 200; (2) boundary BVA — exactly 60 requests (the threshold) all succeed, and 59 requests (threshold-1) also all succeed confirming no premature throttle; (3) negative NEG — a single malformed POST returns 422 (client error 4xx), confirming the error pathway is distinct from rate-limit suppression. Mutation resilience: exact status code assertions (200, 422, 201), exact response counts, exact threshold constant 60 tested at 59 and 60.

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_60_requests_all_return_200_positive():
    client = TestClient(app)
    RATE_LIMIT_THRESHOLD = 60
    statuses = []
    for _ in range(RATE_LIMIT_THRESHOLD):
        r = client.get("/tasks/")
        statuses.append(r.status_code)
    assert len(statuses) == 60
    for i, code in enumerate(statuses):
        assert code == 200, f"Request {i+1} returned {code}, expected 200"
    assert statuses.count(200) == 60

test_60_requests_all_return_200_positive()

tests.name: test_client_error_returns_4xx_not_rate_limit
actions: Send a POST /tasks/ with missing required field 'title'
expected: Response status code is 422 (Unprocessable Entity — client error)
Status code is not 200, not 429, not 500
trace: R-TASK-039 error pathway: HTTP 4xx on client error
NEG: malformed request must yield 422, distinguishing client error from rate-limit suppression
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_client_error_returns_4xx_not_rate_limit():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"description": "no title here", "completed": False})
    assert r.status_code == 422, f"Expected 422, got {r.status_code}"
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 429
    assert r.status_code != 500
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body

test_client_error_returns_4xx_not_rate_limit()

tests.name: test_60_requests_exact_boundary_all_succeed
actions: Send exactly 60 POST /tasks/ requests with valid payloads
expected: No request is rejected with 429 or any non-2xx code
trace: R-TASK-039: 60/min is the exact threshold; all must succeed
BVA: exact threshold value tested; catches constant mutation 60->61 or 60->59
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_60_requests_exact_boundary_all_succeed():
    client = TestClient(app)
    EXACT_THRESHOLD = 60
    statuses = []
    for i in range(EXACT_THRESHOLD):
        payload = {"title": f"Task {i}", "description": None, "completed": False}
        r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
        statuses.append(r.status_code)
    assert len(statuses) == 60
    assert statuses.count(201) == 60, f"Not all 201: {set(statuses)}"
    for i, code in enumerate(statuses):
        assert code == 201, f"Request {i+1} got {code}"

test_60_requests_exact_boundary_all_succeed()

tests.name: test_mixed_endpoints_60_requests_all_2xx
actions: Send 30 GET /tasks/ and 30 GET / requests (60 total)
trace: R-TASK-039: single-client rate across endpoints must not be throttled below 60/min
EP: mixed-endpoint partition; catches rate-limit logic that aggregates across routes
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_mixed_endpoints_60_requests_all_2xx():
    client = TestClient(app)
    statuses = []
    for _ in range(30):
        r = client.get("/tasks/")
        statuses.append(r.status_code)
    for _ in range(30):
        r = client.get("/")
        statuses.append(r.status_code)
    assert len(statuses) == 60
    for i, code in enumerate(statuses):
        assert 200 <= code <= 299, f"Request {i+1} returned {code}, not 2xx"
        assert code == 200, f"Request {i+1} returned {code}, expected 200"
    assert statuses.count(200) == 60

test_mixed_endpoints_60_requests_all_2xx()
